source_en:
Nikatru Subscription Tracker keeps every subscription you pay for in one
list, so the renewal that would have surprised you next month is a thing you
already knew about.

Add each service once with its price and billing cycle. The app works out what
you spend per month and per year, shows the next payment date for each one,
and reminds you before each one renews.

WHAT IT DOES
- One list of every subscription, with price, currency and billing cycle.
- Monthly and yearly totals, recalculated as you edit.
- Next-renewal dates, sorted so the nearest is first.
- Reminders before each renewal.
- Works offline. Your list is stored on your device and stays readable
  without a connection.

WHY IT IS DIFFERENT
It does not ask for access to your bank account and does not read your
transactions. There is no bank login, no card number, no read-only connection
to a financial institution. You tell it what you subscribe to; it does the
arithmetic and the remembering. That is the whole product.

PERMISSIONS
The app asks for notification permission so it can remind you before a
renewal. Decline it and every other feature still works — you just do not get
reminders.

PRIVACY
It does not sell your data and does not show ads. Analytics are off until
you turn them on, and you can delete your account and its data from inside
the app. Full policy: https://nikatru.com/privacy
